### Data Read (17)
- `GET /myhealth_sso/Onboarding/Onboarding/GetUnreadOnboardingContent` — Get unread onboarding content.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/bedside/{bedsideId}` — Get bedside information.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/bulletin/outpatient` — Get outpatient bulletins.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/campaigns/getcampaigns` — Get campaigns.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/datapipeline/alertTypeDescriptor/getAll` — Get all alert type descriptors.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/datapipeline/getDPEventsByPatientId` — Get data pipeline events for a patient.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/directscheduling/{directschedulingId}` — Get direct scheduling information.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/ed/hospitalinfo` — Get hospital information for ED.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/fastpassoffers` — Get fast pass offers.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/messagedraft/drafts` — Get message drafts.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/opennotes/appointmentnotes` — Get appointment notes.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/openOrders/enhanced/ED` — Get enhanced open orders for ED.
- `GET /orion/public/ajax/v1/patient/getDemographics` — Get patient demographics.
- `GET /Private/Ajax/V1/Patients/Providers` — Get a list of a patient's healthcare providers.
- `GET /resources/js/common/i18n/locales/en/{enId}` — Get a specific locale file.
- `POST /myhealth_sso/Clinical/TestResults/GetPageSet` — Get a page set of test results.
- `POST /orion/public/ajax/v1/datapipeline/getDPUnviewedEventsCountByContext` — Get the count of unviewed data pipeline events.

### Data Write (3)
- `POST /myhealth_sso/Clinical/CareTeam/{CareTeamId}` — Update a care team member.
- `POST /myhealth_sso/ToDo/Load` — Load a patient's ToDo list in MyHealth SSO.
- `POST /orion/public/ajax/v1/bedside/connect` — Connect to a patient's bedside system.

### Config (3)
- `GET /Private/Ajax/V1/User/Settings` — Get user settings.
- `GET /WebConfig2.json` — Retrieve web configuration settings.
- `POST /orion/public/ajax/v1/config/getglobalalertconfigs` — Retrieve global alert configurations.

### Core API (2)
- `GET /Private/Ajax/V1/{V1Id}` — Access a generic V1 API endpoint.
- `POST /myhealth_sso/{myhealth_ssoId}` — Perform a MyHealth SSO action.
